newsitem.title: GERMANY: Airlines switch Frankfurt cargo to belly capacity.
newsitem.headline: Airlines switch Frankfurt cargo to belly capacity.

text.p: A trend towards more freight transport in aircraft belly capacity continued at Frankfurt airport in November, Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said.
Cargo carried on passenger services last month rose 7.3 percent to 67,134 tonnes while freighter tonnage grew 3.9 percent to 55,496, the latest FAG traffic report showed.
But from January-November, freighter traffic still shows a 4.8 percent rise compared to a 1.7 percent rise in belly cargo, it noted.
The shift was due to reduced numbers of autumn freighter flights out of Frankfurt caused by market over-capacity, the report said.
Air cargo exports grew strongly by 6.4 percent in November while imports rose 4.9 percent, their second-highest monthly increase this year, the report showed.
Frankfurt airport now looks set to reach its three percent cargo growth target for 1996, industry observers noted. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
